decisions: Bridge node analysis means articulation points in the weak graph; edge direction is ignored consistently with community detection.
Tarjan's algorithm is implemented iteratively to avoid recursion-depth failure on larger graphs.
Parallel relations are deduplicated at the adjacency level, so a second edge between the same endpoints does not create a false bridge.
risks: The result identifies articulation nodes, not edge bridges or weighted betweenness scores; those are separate graph semantics.
Requested subset ids are treated as isolated vertices if absent from storage, matching community detection semantics.
